title: It works .... but nothing fancy but also didn't expect anything fancy
text:
It works .... but nothing fancy but also didn't expect anything fancy. Cute little gum ball machine for the kids in us or to give to actual kids (I kept mine). These are fun to have and who doesn't want a gum ball every now and then? They are easy to fill and use.

So it is made out plastic, so don't expect one that you see at the arcade. This is a little one. Mine worked just fine without any issues. This is a toy and nothing fancy at all so consider the price. I see a lot of disappointed reviews. If you want a fancy one expect to pay a lot more.

product_metadata.title: PlayO 9.75" Spiral Gumball Machine Toy - Kids Dubble Bubble Twirling Style Galaxy Candy Dispenser - Birthday Parties, Novelties, Party Favors and Supplies (Gumballs sold separately)
features: SWIRLING FUN - Load with any kind of small knick-knacks, but note the gumballs here are not included! Push it down from the top and watch the toothsome goodie roll along the colorful spiral. This will certainly ignite your children’s imagination like they are in a candy world.

NIBBLE IN STYLE - Ideal food accent to put on event tables as a centerpiece or attraction to kids. Fill the container with inch size jelly beans, peanuts, gumdrops, gummies, nougats, and other sweetmeats. Adds excitement because a sucker treat drops randomly.

Size9.75” – Our bubble gum dispenser is 9.75 inches tall. This makes for a perfect size to put on a counter or table top. Made of sturdy plastic that means our product is lightweight yet durable to ensure it lasts for a long time.

PERFECT GIFT - Our bubble gum dispensing machine makes for a perfect and novel gift for kids and adults alike on their birthday. Also makes for an excellent Christmas gift and a fun addition to your parties.

FUN AND ATTRACTIVE – Your kids will love our bubble gum machine. The spiral design of the gumball machine means they can push the top and see the gumballs twirling down to the bottom and have endless fun.
